purpose: ngspice's behavioural C networks: c= (G/R/C/V/B, i = C(v) dv/dt) and q= (G/L/B, i = dq/dt), with m, tc1 and an X card's m

oracle.derivation: A current ramp i = k t (k = 1e3 A/s) puts Q = k t^2/2 on each node from v = 0. C(v) = C0(1 + a v), q(v) = C0(v + a v^2/2), C0 = 1n, a = 0.5/V, give C0(v + a v^2/2) = Q/s, v = (sqrt(1 + 2 a Q/(s C0)) - 1)/a; s = 1 for ca and cb, 2/1.1 for cc (m = 2, the B divided by 1 + tc1*100 = 1.1, reciproctc=1), 2 for xd (X card m=2 on the q= network's G).
oracle.corroboration: ngspice-45 .meas on this deck agrees to 1e-5 (ngspice -b behavioural_capacitor.sp)
oracle.tolerance: rtol 1e-4: the transient's own discretization error, measured at 1.3e-6 in ngspice-45 with the 2 ns step cap
